anti_overlap: Do not review the ApocryphaEntry schema's fields for record integrity, dedup keys, serialization round-trips, or who is credited as the teller — entry identity and provenance belong to the transmission lens.
Do not analyze F3 ledger fragility, repeated reloads of the same save merging into one entry, or eviction-as-lost-record; those are the other lens's findings.

Do not audit individual strings for second person, machine vocabulary, or attribution frames as a compliance checklist — §2.5 already states those rules; only raise word-level issues when the problem is dose, contrast, or accumulation.
Do not re-argue the precedent survey in §5 or propose additional reference games.
Do not review Rust implementation details, module layout, or the elf-revel codebase; the target is a design document with no code.
Do not restate the three open questions in §6 as findings.

Round-1 lenses already hold neighbouring ground: fd-failure-as-content-tone-calibration owns precedent inheritance and the guardrail catalogue, so raise budget issues only where the argument is about dose SHAPE, habituation, saturation, or channel competition rather than whether a cap exists.

fd-oral-tradition-mythopoeic-drift owns the linguistics of how a telling drifts and compresses; approach the three registers as phases of one composition and their perceived novelty over time, not as a prose-generation problem.
decision_lens: Does the proposed dose and unfolding produce recognition and pleasure at every stage of the composition's life, or does it fade into an unnoticed constant, saturate around one subject, or displace the material it sits beside? And does the capture actually recover the thing worth telling, or only what happened to be volatile at the moment of sampling?
distance_rationale: Perfumery shares no lineage with software, narrative design, or game systems, and it is the only mature professional practice whose entire discipline is the management of an involuntary emotional response over time under a strict budget of parts per thousand. It knows two things the spike needs and does not have language for: that a composition's failure mode is usually not offense but HABITUATION — the nose stops reporting a constant stimulus within minutes — and that capturing the scent of something alive without destroying it (headspace) recovers only what volatilizes into the chamber, never the whole flower. Both map directly onto a mechanism whose stated success condition is a grin and whose capture method is a diff taken at the moment the living world is discarded.
expected_isomorphisms: Headspace capture of a living flower before it is cut ↔ §2.2's digest of the live world before discarding it, and the materials that never volatilize into the chamber ↔ everything that arose and resolved inside the gap and so leaves no diff; top/heart/base notes ↔ the three registers of §2.3 (days later, a season on, an era on); the drydown, where cheap compositions reveal themselves as the same accord thinned ↔ spike finding 2 ('nothing compresses'); dosage as the difference between a beautiful indolic trace and a latrine ↔ open question 1's 'rarer and louder'; anosmia and olfactory fatigue under constant low exposure ↔ the one-line-per-day, once-per-season trickle; sillage and projection ↔ the colony-wide cap and how far a telling carries into the ordinary news stream; a fixative that claims to be inert but mutes everything above it ↔ F5's 'flavor has no hands' additive-only rule; the brief (the emotional effect is the specification, the materials are chosen against it) ↔ §1's grin-not-scolded absolute.
focus: Whether the composition actually delivers the intended response over its whole duration: what the capture method can and cannot recover from the abandoned night, whether the three registers are genuinely different phases or one accord at three dilutions, and whether the proposed dose produces recognition and delight or habituation, saturation, and displacement of the surrounding material.
name: fd-perfumery-dosage
persona: Apply the perspective of a perfumer composing to a brief where the specified deliverable is an emotional response, not a list of materials. This framework treats the brief's stated feeling as the only acceptance test and every technical decision as subordinate to it. It holds that concentration is not a volume knob but a change of character: the same molecule reads as skin at a trace and as an accusation at a percent, so any question about how often something appears is a question about what it MEANS. It expects a composition to evolve — a base note that is merely the top note thinned is the signature of a cheap formula, and the wearer stops noticing the whole thing within the hour. It knows that the failure of a constant, well-behaved, low-level presence is not irritation but anosmia: the nose reports change, not level, so an even trickle disappears while a pulse stays perceptible at a lower total dose. It is sceptical of any material described as inert, because a fixative that adds nothing perceptible still occupies the base and mutes what sits above it. And it knows headspace capture recovers only what was volatile in the chamber at the moment of sampling, so it always asks what the sample silently omits.
review_areas: Capture fidelity versus the reload motive: §2.2 diffs the discarded live world against the save being loaded, so only NET state change survives. Check what a player most often reloads for — a revel that went badly, a mood spiral, a relationship soured and patched, a near-miss — and whether those leave a net diff at all. If the disaster resolved or was absorbed before the player loaded, the chamber was empty when it was sampled, and the mechanism produces nothing at precisely the moments it exists for. Weigh this against the doc's claim that state diff 'works for any gap length'.

The discriminator's dependence on knowledge the doc says does not exist: §2.1 condition (c) requires that the gap contain at least one chronicle-worthy event (departure, salon rung change, revel incident, naming, dissolution), while §2.2 and finding 5 establish that events are transient per tick and no journal exists. Check how condition (c) is evaluated at load time without the journal, whether it collapses into 'the diff was non-empty', and what that identity does to the doc's own worked cases in §2.1.

Register evolution versus dilution: §2.3's three registers and finding 2 both circle the same issue. Check whether 'an era on' introduces genuinely different material (a different claim, a different teller, a different shape of sentence) or is 'days later' with name-drift and a shedding pass applied. The §3 samples are the evidence: compare what actually CHANGES between the three lines about Halymiek. A base note that is the top note thinned is the composition telling the player there was nothing underneath.

Dose shape and habituation: §2.4 proposes an even trickle — one line per day colony-wide, an entry at most once per season, indefinitely. Check this against the response the brief specifies. A constant low-level presence is the regime that produces habituation fastest; recognition requires contrast, which requires silence around the telling. Consider whether the register should go quiet for long stretches and land in pulses, and whether the doc's default is defended anywhere or merely proposed.

Saturation and projection around a subject: nothing in §2.4 caps entries per subject. Check the case of a player who reloads repeatedly to save one elf, accumulating several entries all naming them; every mention of that elf then arrives pre-mythologized. Each line individually passes the §2.5 audit, so the string-level guardrails are structurally blind to this — the tone failure is produced by concentration, not by word choice.

The additive claim under channel scarcity: F5 and §2.5 assert flavor has no hands, but check whether an apocrypha line and an ordinary salon line compete for the same surface, the same daily slot, or the same reader attention. If the news channel is capacity-bound, an added line is a displaced line, and a mechanism that quietly costs the player live colony news is subtractive wearing an additive label — the fixative that claims to be inert while muting everything above it.

Timing relative to the player rather than the tick: the first surfacing at 1 to 3 days (§2.4) assumes continuous play. Check the player who reloads and then quits for a week; the recognition window has passed in ticks but not in their memory, and the top note evaporated before anyone smelled it.

severity_examples.condition: P0 because the discriminator is the design's load-bearing decision and the doc contains the refutation of its own gating condition three paragraphs later; every downstream section inherits the ambiguity.
severity_examples.scenario: §2.1's discriminator requires a chronicle-worthy event in the gap, but §2.2 and finding 5 establish that no event journal exists — so the only thing the load-time check can actually test is whether the state diff came back non-empty. Condition (c) is unimplementable as written by the doc's own argument, which means the mechanism's entire gate is undefined and the worked cases in §2.1 do not follow from any implementable rule.

severity_examples.condition: P1 because the mechanism's hit rate is inversely correlated with the emotional weight of the reload, so the grin fires on the wrong nights; drops to P2 only if revel_history's append-only records demonstrably cover the common bad-revel case.
severity_examples.scenario: A player reloads because a revel went badly and moods cratered, but by the time they load, moods have partly recovered, nobody departed, and the salon rung is unchanged; the diff is empty or trivial, and the night that hurt enough to make them reload produces no apocrypha at all — while a quiet gap in which one elf happened to leave for unrelated reasons produces a full gospel.

severity_examples.condition: P2 rather than P1 because §6 question 1 already routes rate to the owner; escalate to P1 only for the structural half the question does not ask — that an even trickle and a rare pulse are different mechanisms, not two settings of one dial.
severity_examples.scenario: The one-line-per-day, once-per-season budget runs indefinitely and evenly, so after two in-game seasons the player reads apocrypha lines the way they read weather — a constant, well-behaved background that no longer registers as anything. The register keeps working, the strings all pass audit, and the grin has quietly stopped happening.

source_domain: Perfumery composition and dosage: the craft of building an accord that unfolds over hours — headspace capture of a living flower, top/heart/base construction, the drydown, sillage and projection, and the perfumer's governing knowledge that the same material is exquisite at trace concentration and repellent at ten times that.
success_hints: Use the §3 sample material as the primary evidence: read the three Halymiek lines side by side and state exactly which words differ, then judge whether that difference is a phase change or a dilution.
For each of the five diff sources named in §2.2, construct the ordinary play episode that would most make a player want to reload, and check whether that episode leaves a net state difference at all.

Separate the dose QUESTION already routed to the owner in §6 from the dose STRUCTURE the doc never examines — shape, contrast, saturation per subject, and channel competition are not what question 1 asks.

Where the tone risk is produced by accumulation rather than wording, say so explicitly and note that the §2.5 string audit cannot detect it, so the guardrail set has a structural blind spot rather than a weak rule.
Prefer findings that name a concrete player episode and the line the player would actually see over abstract statements about pacing.
Stay off record-keeping, entry identity, dedup, and attribution provenance; another lens owns those.
task_context: Reviewing docs/plans/2026-08-28-apocrypha-spike.md, a pre-build design spike for elf-revel in which reloading a save canonizes the abandoned timeline as contested apocrypha in the salon chronicle (cujgel R9). No shipping code exists yet; the deliverable under review is the mechanism design itself: the discriminator (§2.1), state-diff capture and the ApocryphaEntry schema (§2.2), canonization registers (§2.3), the surfacing budget (§2.4), the tone guardrails (§2.5), the real sample material and spike findings (§3, §4), and failure modes F1 through F5 (§5). Stress the reload-as-apocrypha design before build: does the mechanism (state-diff capture, discriminator, surfacing budget, additive-only rule) actually deliver the grin-not-scolded success condition, and what failure mode is the doc still blind to? Section 6 lists three open questions already routed to the project owner; findings that merely restate those questions add nothing. Severity: P0 = would corrupt or block the whole design; P1 = must fix before implementing; P2 = degrades quality; P3 = polish.
